name: IPIP Honesty-Humility facets (preliminary HEXACO-PI proxies)
citation: Preliminary IPIP scales measuring constructs similar to those in Lee and Ashton's HEXACO Personality Inventory. Goldberg, L. R. (1999). A broad-bandwidth, public domain, personality inventory measuring the lower-level facets of several five-factor models. In I. Mervielde et al. (Eds.), Personality Psychology in Europe, Vol. 7 (pp. 7-28). Tilburg University Press.
licence: Public domain. https://ipip.ori.org/newPermission.htm: permission has already been automatically granted for any person to use IPIP items, scales, and inventories for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial.
attribution: Items from the International Personality Item Pool (https://ipip.ori.org/).
instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age. So that you can describe yourself in an honest manner, your responses will be kept in absolute confidence. Indicate for each statement whether it is 1. Very Inaccurate, 2. Moderately Inaccurate, 3. Neither Accurate Nor Inaccurate, 4. Moderately Accurate, or 5. Very Accurate as a description of you.
notes: IPIP labels these scales preliminary. They are IPIP proxies, not the HEXACO-PI-R itself. The domain score pools all 40 items. Item order is interleaved.
